ios.desc:
The ultimate conversion tool for travelers, professionals, and everyday users.

ConverterGo makes converting measurements, currencies, cryptocurrencies, and time zones effortless and fast. Say goodbye to multiple apps—get everything in one beautifully designed, easy-to-use tool.

Key Features :

• Unit Converter: Instantly convert in multiple categories such as weight, length, temperature, volume, speed, and more!

• Currency Converter: Supports 170 fiat currencies.

• Crypto Converter: Supports major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and more.

• World Clock: Check current times and time zones for cities around the world.

• Favorites Tab: Save your most-used conversions for quick and easy access

• Offline Support: Make conversions even with no internet access.

• Simple Interface: Designed for speed and ease of use.

Unlock Even More with ConverterGo Premium:

• Remove ads 
• Save unlimited favorites
• Get faster currency rate updates (every 60 seconds)
• Unlock full historical currency data 
• Access convenient home screen widgets (iOS 17+)
• Visual Time Converter
• Custom Color Themes

ConverterGo Premium is available via an optional subscription with two choices:
- $3.99 per month
- $24.99 per year (best value)
Pricing may vary by country. Both plans include a 7-day free trial so you can try all features risk-free!

Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings in the App Store. 

Whether you’re a student, traveler, business professional, or just need quick conversions, ConverterGo has you covered.

Download ConverterGo now and simplify your conversions!
